1530801.name: Beam Machine Gun
1530801.description: Fires the machine gun on the right arm, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1530802.name: Dispersing Missile
1530802.description:
Fires missiles from both wings, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Missiles can be intercepted.

1530803.name: Heavy Particle Blade
1530803.description: Swings a beam blade that can pierce through cover, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1530804.name: Flowline Beam Port
1530804.description: Fires off lasers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1530805.name: High-Density Heavy Particle Cannon
1530805.description: Fires powerful particle cannons from both shoulders, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Any Nikkes who are hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

1530807.name: Dispersing Missile II
1530807.description:
Fires missiles from both wings, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Missiles can be intercepted.

1530809.name: Beam Burst
1530809.description: Charges the machine gun on her right arm with energy before shooting a laser. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.
